summary: Added the five password rules to the sign-up page, listed under the password field; on submit each unmet rule turns red and shows its specific error message, and password validation runs before the match/duplicate-email checks.
conventions: Sign-up passwords must be at least 8 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number and one special character (any non-alphanumeric); the rules are always visible under the password field and each unmet rule shows its own error on submit

visual_check.evidence: The /signup page shows all five password rules (8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, special character) as a bulleted list directly under the Password field, matching the instruction.

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API here: signup persists entirely client-side via src/store.js, which writes a map keyed by lowercased, trimmed email into localStorage under the key 'acme-users' (and sessionStorage 'acme-current' for the current user). Password rule ids are 'length', 'upper', 'lower', 'number', 'special'; navigation on success goes to '/login'.
